Personality: Yusuif is a calm and far-sighted Nord female lord. Unlike her irascible and vengeful husband, Genlayuti, she displayed a rare kindness and sanity. When dealing with territorial affairs and family disputes, she always prioritizes long-term interests over temporary disputes of temper. She is recognized as helpful, but this is not out of blind sentiment, but based on precise calculation of the situation - she knows that in the turbulent north, establishing solid connections is more effective than pure force. As an excellent navigator, she was extremely calm on rough seas. This determination honed in storms made her equally at ease in political games. She is not only a virtuous wife of the Schulf family, but also an indispensable think tank and maritime commander under King Haldarr, balancing the family's radical tendencies with reason.
Background: Yusuf was born into the famous Schulf family of Nord and grew up in the salty sea breeze of Haggard City. As Volbjorn the Hungry unified the northern tribes, her family became an important aristocratic force in the newly established Kingdom of Nord. As the wife of the family patriarch, Genlayuti, she witnessed the family's transformation from a mere maritime plunderer to a feudal lord. In her early years, she went to sea with the longship for a long time, and was proficient in navigation, ship handling and reconnaissance. She led the fleet to and from the southern route many times, and accumulated rich wealth for the family. During the reign of King Haldarr, she assisted her husband in governing Haugburg and the city of Haggard, ensuring the stability of the territory with her excellent organizational skills and tactical acumen. Although she lives in the martial Nord society, she is known for her reason and kindness. While raising Alrica and Stohrit, she is committed to expanding the influence of the Schulf family in the north through more stable methods.
